Police responded to calls just before 10am yesterday. (ABC Goldfields: Nicholas R Ward)

Bevan Watson, 38, faced the Kalgoorlie Magistrates Court on Monday, charged with the murder of a 35-year-old woman.

The woman was found dead on the side of Goldfields Highway, on the outskirts of Kalgoorlie-Boulder, late on Friday.

Mr Watson has been remanded in custody, and will face court again later this month.

A man has faced court in Western Australia's Goldfields, accused of murdering a woman found dead next to a remote highway.

The 35-year-old woman, who cannot be identified for cultural reasons, was found on the side of Goldfields Highway, 600km east of Perth, just after 10am on Friday.

Homicide Squad Detectives charged 38-year-old Bevan Watson with the woman's murder late on Sunday.

Mr Watson made a brief appearance in the Kalgoorlie Magistrates Court on Monday. He did not enter a plea and was remanded in custody.

Police are urging anyone with information to contact Crime Stoppers. (ABC Goldfields: Nicholas R Ward)

Police have said Mr Watson was known to the woman, although the nature of that relationship was not disclosed in court.

He is due to face the Stirling Gardens Magistrates Court in Perth, via video link from custody, on June 24.

Detectives have asked anyone with information, dash cam or CCTV footage near where the woman's body was found to contact Crime Stoppers on 1800 333 000.
